discovery.title: Children are not colorblind: Why early conversations about race are essential
discovery.summary: Discussing racism with children can seem daunting to parents, caregivers and educators for several reasons. Often, it can feel uncomfortable talking about people's differences; conversations about racism reveal implicit biases and, for some, immense privilege.
